description: XSUAA security descriptor for BTP deployment. Inert for local dev — see package.json's cds.requires.auth (mocked kind, [production] overrides to xsuaa).

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.PricingViewer
scopes.description: Pricing API: load context, calculate costs and prices, view traces, write back to C4C. No config access.

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.PricingAdmin
scopes.description: Everything PricingViewer has, plus the full config API: read, create, edit, version and activate rules and tables, and the AI-suggestion pipeline.
